correctness.rationale: Neutral reproductive values π=(1,2,2,1)/6 define a voter-model fixation martingale. Differentiating neighbor fitness weighting gives explicit active-edge drift; duality reduces quadratic moments under the sum of single-cooperator/single-defector laws to six two-lineage survival probabilities Q^t 1. Coalescence on finite connected P4 makes ρ(Q)<1 and sums the full infinite-time periodic drift via (I−Q³)^−1. The cost contribution is −4c/21; three distinct benefit coefficients are 12920/259077, 1730/37011 and 11981/259077. Reversal swaps L,R, exhaustive six permutations cover all cases. Independent rational SymPy inversion of the exact 6×6 Q reproduces all six benefit/cost coefficients, three b/c thresholds, and signs at (4,1). The source also uses separate 14 transient-state differentiation. Analytic finite absorbing-chain inversion justifies sufficiently weak δ>0, not large δ or derivative-equality endpoints.

final_claim: On P4 with uniformly located phase-zero mutant and periodic one-edge donation-game snapshots under death–birth updating, exactly six edge orders have three weak-selection threshold classes; at b=4,c=1 central-first is favorable and center-last/middle unfavorable, reversing a low-hub-first heuristic.
limitations: One-edge-per-time-step three-period deterministic snapshots, P4 fixed replacement graph, uniform phase-zero mutant, donation game and sufficiently weak positive selection only.
No claim about the actual H=q/ell rule, arbitrary temporal graphs, phase-averaged mutants, or strong selection.
